name: Multi-Head Causal Attention: two heads, one mask
description: Two maps, striped above the diagonal; needs a download

data.noteContent:
Two heads and a mask, on the chain Self-Attention 101 already walks. embed_dim 8 splits into 2 heads of 4, each attends on its own, and W_o mixes them back to 8. The mask stops a position reading anything to its right, so the first row of each map is 1 then zeros. The sentence is 5 tokens, so the heatmap on Edu-MultiHeadAttention holds 2 panels of 5 by 5, striped wherever the mask blocked a cell. Nothing here is trained. The pack's C4-3 example adds the LayerNorms and residual adds that make this a whole block. The first run downloads the cl100k_base table.

兩個 head 加上一個遮罩，走的是 Self-Attention 101 那條鏈。embed_dim 8 拆成 2 個 4 維的 head，各自做一次 attention，再由 W_o 混回 8 維。遮罩不讓任何位置讀到自己右邊，所以每張圖的第一列都是 1、之後全是 0。這句話有 5 個 token，所以 Edu-MultiHeadAttention 上的熱圖是 2 張 5 列 5 欄，被遮罩擋掉的格子畫上斜線。這裡沒有任何東西訓練過。這個套件包的 C4-3 範例補上 LayerNorm 和殘差相加，那才是完整的一個 block。第一次執行會下載 cl100k_base 表。

Two heads means embed_dim 8 split into two subspaces of 4, each scored separately. The panels differ because the two halves of W_q and W_k differ, not because anything learned them -- it takes training before heads take on distinct jobs.

兩個 head 就是把 embed_dim 8 切成兩個 4 維子空間，各自算分數。兩張圖不一樣，是因為 W_q 和 W_k 的兩半不一樣，不是因為學到了什麼 — 要訓練過，head 才會各自分工。

The FFN works on one token at a time: 8 up to 16, gelu, back down to 8. Attention mixes across positions, this mixes across features, and a block alternates the two. In production hidden_dim is usually four times embed_dim.

FFN 一次只處理一個 token：8 放大到 16，過 gelu，再收回 8。Attention 是在位置之間混，這裡是在特徵之間混，一個 block 就是兩者輪流。實務上 hidden_dim 通常是 embed_dim 的四倍。
